Egypt coach waves Palestinian flag after World Cup win

Egypt's national football coach, Hossam Hassan, was seen waving a Palestinian flag following his team's World Cup victory over Australia. Separately, Zlatan Ibrahimovic offered support to Australian player Herrington after a penalty miss.
